open_findings.detail: The shipped default binaries (oep-pdm, oep-pdm-stub) call service::serve_from_args with NO authorizer; the P11-T03 authz boundary is OPT-IN (PdmService::start_with_authorizer), so the product as shipped is default-open. The committed auth_boundary.rs exercises only the in-process opt-in path and never asserts the shipped default binary denies. Pen-test finding P2T-04-AZ (authz surface, HIGH) was tracked to P11-T03 but is substantively unresolved on the union. BLOCKS the release drill (drill acceptance: pen-test findings resolved or waived) until fixed or explicitly waived.
